sql:
SELECT r.positionOrder 
FROM results AS r 
JOIN drivers AS d ON r.driverId = d.driverId 
JOIN races AS ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId 
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton' AND ra.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND ra.year = 2008
